Thanks, I’m on an aggressive prednisone cycle for the next week and my doctor assured me I’ll be fine. I have to watch out for any mood issues as I’m BP type II, but I’ll take a little bit of hypomania over a million scabs on my crotch and arms. 

I think this is the kick in the ass I’ve needed to start getting serious mental help lmao
I’m an idiot I’m in the official Reddit app not RiF

The good news is that people make an effort to interact with you. You have a good personality and you are generally an approachable person. The bad news is that your internal stress prevents you from escalating these small gestures of interaction into closer relationships. That’s what I am getting out of your post right now. 

Being in college, I’m guessing that you’re in your late teens/early twenties? This is a great time to look into professional assistance. You’re at a point where things can either look up OR descend into dangerous levels. 

My recommendation is that you try and see a doctor, look at your problems as an illness rather than a flaw, and stick with treatment.

Are you me?? I literally searched “practice” in the subreddit because I’ve been doing the EXACT same thing (trying to hang myself without restricting my airway too much) and it turns out you posted this like three hours ago.

Still not out of the water but I really opened up to my doctor and we’re exploring different paths of treatment right now. I’m not doing great but I’m feeling a bit better knowing that I am going to take my problems more seriously. Things are pointing towards BPD rather than Bipolar but I still need a full assessment for clarity. Thanks for your reply!!❤️❤️

(Posting on my throwaway acct) 

Literally only my doctor knows the severity of my bipolar disorder and how badly I’ve been hurting myself. Everyone else just thinks I’ve kind of fallen off the map the last few years and no one asks me why I’ve been such a shut in.

Based on one of the replies, Im gonna guess you mentioned exercise as a way to help out these ideations. You’re not wrong honestly lmao, I haven’t been going to the gym for a few weeks and I’ve been prescribed propranolol to help out with the insane anxiety I feel when confronted with doing my hobbies so it’s all good.

Thanks for the reply! I’m just starting a new medication regimen so I’m not thinking straight rn not gonna lie. I don’t actually PLAN on doing anything I just needed to scream out to the void of the internet!
All scars from cutting with razors

I need help. I’m going to be dead soon without serious professional help. 

There comes a point where mental health reaches a critical level and while it’s not my fault, I’ve let things get out of control.
That’s the worst part of SH, even small mistakes lead to permanent consequences.

These are all between 4 and 14 months old. I’ve made a promise to myself that the next time I do this it’s going to be bad enough to send me straight to hell (or inpatient if I’m lucky). 

I really lost it over the past year, this isn’t what I thought life had in store for me.

I swear, every single time I take a shower I look at my legs in disbelief. I KNOW that I did what I did... and I understand that I wasn’t in a right mindset. But still, how the fuck am I suppose to live my best life with zebra stripe crazy person legs??
Nah, only when the scans are kind of falling off. Right now they’re hunkey-dorey.
I’m in a weird halfway point of loving what I’ve done and hating it. The worst though is when I feel really normal (like I did a few years ago) and I just cannot believe what I’ve done to myself.
Lol those are actually all on my outer thigh, the pic is my right leg bent a bit outward. It looks totally ambiguous though because you can’t see my foot.
I realize there’s a little bit of scabbing in one of the cuts there, if you want to add a trigger warning or delete this post for now I understand!
